sections.heading: Core model
sections.content: Arrays have fixed length and are values. A slice is a descriptor over an underlying array with length and capacity. `append` may reuse the current array or allocate a new one, so retain its returned slice. Sub-slices can keep a large backing array alive and can share mutable elements. Use `copy` when an independent snapshot is required. Maps provide key-value lookup; reading an absent key returns the value type's zero value, so use the comma-ok form when absence differs from a stored zero. Never write to a nil map.
keyPoints: Arrays have fixed length and are values.
commonMistakes: fallthrough must be explicit and is often avoidable
passing an array copies all elements
